name: story-owner-lease
title: Implement the story owner lease (local session ownership)
description: Implement the story owner lease — session-ownership-and-write-leases.md rollout step 2b (the second half of the implementation; main write lock = step 2a = B-f60c, done). LOCAL Koala session ownership only: a stable per-session `sessionId` is a process-coordination id, NOT cryptographic identity — no public/private keys, no server authority, no reviewer attestation. The owner lease protects story authoring / lifecycle mutation ownership; it must NOT cancel reviewer/verifier independent write rights — reviewer read-only flows are always allowed, and reviewer writes (finding_add / review_pass_set) get an actor/lane-scoped exception (their own current-review-run gate), NOT the main-agent owner lease, so three-way balance is preserved. The non-owner rejection gate is built strictly from a command-classification table that PLAN must produce first (read-only / story-scoped mutating / main-shared mutating / dangerous). This story does NOT refactor the main write lock (B-f60c) — it only calls the existing lock where needed. Out of scope: reviewer identity / attestation, cryptographic identity, server authority, cross-clone locking.
